mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_t (id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_t WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE order_t SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE order_t SET status = 2, shipping_company = #{shippingCompany}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, ship_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE order_t SET status = 3, receive_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
